provenance.recorded: 2026-10-31, observed from a live three-way arbitration run (`python -X utf8 -m symmetry_court arbitrate --emit-expected-template`); the receipt is verdicts/dhcp.verdict.json; the gate (`python -X utf8 -m symmetry_court selftest`) replays the case and compares these rows field-by-field
provenance.reading_guide: relabel row = actions may be renamed along with states (diagnostic contrast reading for an event-class model); fixed row = event names pinned (the protocol-true reading, declared in each group file); networkx columns = independent juror

renew_rebind.claim: defendant A: RENEWING and REBINDING are the protocol's own twin pair -- both are lease-extension waiting rooms that send DHCPREQUEST and leave on the identical 'DHCPACK/Record lease' label -- so they could be swapped and compressed into one state

reboot_rebind.claim: defendant B: REBOOTING and REBINDING have the same graph shape -- exactly one in-neighbor, two outgoing edges, both toward BOUND and INIT -- so they could be swapped

init_start.claim: defendant C (control): INIT and INIT-REBOOT are both starting states of the diagram, so they could be swapped

pads.claim: positive control: padding states 8 and 9 have byte-identical rows (every event self-loops, reward 0), so the swap is a genuine symmetry under BOTH readings and should be admitted everywhere
